title: Ionic Protocol — paused oracle-less Compound fork on Mode/Base/Lisk/OP; $0 unprivileged-extractable
closed_reasons: mint + borrow guardian-paused on every market of all 5 Ionic deployments (65 markets)

ionLBTC market: depositor is a market member, so redeem/redeemUnderlying/transfer/exitMarket all revert 'Price oracle not found for this underlying token address' (MasterPriceOracle has no LBTC price; assigned oracle reverts)
liquidateBorrow of the depositor and of other meaningful borrowers reverts (missing oracle for LBTC/weETH/STONE/wrsETH/M-BTC/uniBTC or stale-feed custom error 0x42753799); only dust shortfalls exist
seize() from an EOA returns SEIZE_MARKET_NOT_LISTED (seizer must be a listed market)
flash() is callable by anyone (FeeDistributor.canCall=true) but selfTransferIn enforces atomic repayment; honest flash yields zero profit
_withdrawAdminFees/_withdrawIonicFees are permissionless but bounded by accrued fees and pay comptroller.admin()/ionicAdmin
Mode LBTC peg-out closed: isWithdrawalsEnabled=false (never enabled), treasury=0x0, zero bridge destinations; redeem reverts WithdrawalsDisabled()
only LBTC venue on Mode (Balancer LBTC/wBTC pool) has swaps disabled (BAL#402); no other pool exists
no cToken Approval events ever on ionLBTC -> no third party can move the depositor's cTokens
key_facts: Mode-A comptroller 0xFB3323E24743Caf4ADD0fDCCFB268565c0685556 has 18 markets; admin is a Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 threshold 2 (owners 0x03A376.., 0x737898.., 0x5A9e79.., 0x1155b614..)
ionLBTC market 0xADE794534c05F79981337E73dc2A987cdFf1958d holds 249.00006075 LBTC (cash 24,900,006,075, totalBorrows 5,000 wei, exchangeRateCurrent 0.2e18)

depositor 0x9E34d89C013Da3BF65fc02b59B6F27D710850430 owns 124,500,000,000 of 124,500,055,375 cTokens (99.99996%) and is a member of 12 markets; it is the protocol's largest BORROWER (~$5M debt across 11 markets), not a passive holder
the only other holder 0x1155b614971f16758C92c4890eD338C9e3ede6b7 (55,375 cTokens, NOT a member) can redeem 0.00011075 LBTC because non-members bypass the liquidity/oracle check
oracle 0x2BAF3A2B667A5027a83101d218A9e8B73577F117 reverts for LBTC, weETH, STONE, wrsETH, uniBTC ('Price oracle not found'); M-BTC oracle reverts too
all 18 Mode-A markets, 4 Mode-B markets, 28 Base markets, 10 OP markets and 5 Lisk markets have mintGuardianPaused=true and borrowGuardianPaused=true; transfer/seize are not paused

Mode LBTC 0x964dd444e3192F636322229080A576077B06FbA3 is Lombard's native LBTC (not a LayerZero OFT); withdrawals disabled, treasury unset, no bridge destinations; Ethereum LBTC has withdrawals enabled (Mode deployment is the closed one)
Balancer pool 0xcc53c20aD428359FbaEF29684Dd2c9B55F378ce6 holds 3.99999097 LBTC + 0.20016459 WBTC (~$16.9k) but Vault.swap reverts BAL#402 SWAP_DISABLED
nominal 249.00006075 LBTC = $21,132,250 at LBTC $84,869.01 (DefiLlama 2026-10-03); realizable by anyone unprivileged today = $0
38,294-entry borrower registry; sampled top-25 historical borrowers per debt market: meaningful accounts getAccountLiquidity reverts, only dust shortfalls (<= ~$0.20)
caveats: USD values are nominal at DefiLlama prices 2026-10-03 (LBTC $84,869.01, BTC $84,571.50, ETH $2,681.55); Mode LBTC has no native price so ETH-LBTC parity is used for the nominal figure only

borrower scan covered the top-25 historical borrowers per debt market (89 rows: 71 getAccountLiquidity reverts, 8 healthy, 10 dust shortfalls totalling ~$6.5), not all 38,294 registry entries; no material shortfall was found in the sampled set
getAccountLiquidity reverts for accounts holding any broken-oracle market, so their exact health cannot be computed - but the same revert blocks their liquidation

value could move after privileged actions: (1) adding an LBTC oracle unblocks holder redemption/liquidation checks; (2) the LBTC owner enabling withdrawals + setting a treasury restores BTC peg-out (then limited by redemption logistics)
the Balancer pool composition may change if swaps are re-enabled; the $16.9k buy-side figure is as of block ~45.43M
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Ionic: every market is mint+borrow paused, the LBTC oracle reverts so the member depositor cannot redeem/transfer/exit, liquidations are blocked by missing/stale oracles (dust shortfalls only), flash() is repayment-enforced, and the 249 LBTC ($21.13M nominal) is stuck behind a disabled Mode-LBTC peg-out with no working DEX - only privileged oracle/owner action could unlock it.
